claim.claim-text: 2. The digital pathology apparatus of claim 1, wherein the electromagnetic shielding material is not applied to the interior surface of the at least one side of the housing comprising one or more openings.
3. The digital pathology apparatus of claim 1 or 2, wherein the electromagnetic shielding material is a fabric and is secured to the interior surface of the housing by an adhesive.

4. The digital pathology apparatus of claim 3, wherein the fabric is applied to the interior surface of the housing by spraying a contact adhesive on the interior surface of the housing and pressing the fabric onto the adhesive covered interior surface of the housing.
5. The digital pathology apparatus of any of the preceding claims, wherein the electromagnetic shielding material does not vary in its effectiveness of electromagnetic shielding.
6. The digital pathology apparatus of any of the preceding claims, wherein the electromagnetic shielding material is Shieldex Nora Dell - CR.
7. The digital pathology apparatus of any of the preceding claims, including a sensor and latch system to identify when the housing is in an open position.
8. The digital pathology apparatus of any of the preceding claims, wherein the housing is configured to slide along a rail system to allow access to the electrical components of the apparatus.
9. The digital pathology apparatus of claim 8, wherein the housing is further configured to securely latch when closed.
10. The digital pathology apparatus of any of the preceding claims, wherein the housing includes a speakerless audio system.

11. The digital pathology apparatus of claim 10, wherein the speakerless audio system includes one or more exciters that engage an internal surface of the housing that is not covered by the electromagnetic shielding material.
